description: DSS for unit commitment and load shedding is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Gina Rakotonirainy (AIMS). Contains AIMMS files for setting up and running decision support systems for unit commitment and scheduling of load shedding. Accompanies MSc thesis "Decision support for the production and distribution of electricity under load shedding", R. Georgina Rakotonirainy, University of Cape Town and AIMS South Africa (2016). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2016. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
